title: SCH-CNT-002 permanent PowerUp definition
description: A permanent PowerUp definition. The project-owned typed validator in src/MechaMiner.Content/Categories/ remains authoritative; this schema is the draft 2020-12 mirror kept for editor and tool interoperability, and a fixture corpus proves the two reach the same accept/reject verdict on every structural case. See content/schemas/README.md. A PowerUp is a kind, a per-rank value, a cap, and a price array; the authored shape had twenty-five fields of which the maximum effect, every rank's running total, and every cumulative cost were arithmetic over those four. The shared purchase-rule flags are not declared: nine fields identical across all thirteen definitions are a catalog rule.

id.title: A stable, case-sensitive ASCII content ID

ui_grouping.description: Which shop group this PowerUp appears under.

affected_statistic.description: A statistic from the shared vocabulary every trait, utility, PowerUp and relic modifies.

effect_kind.description: How the per-rank value contributes. A closed five-way union replacing five parallel optional value keys of which exactly one was ever present; the unit is carried by the token, which is why there is one value and not five.

per_rank_value.description: What one rank adds. A permanent PowerUp is an always-on improvement, so a rank that took something away would be a different concept.

exclusiveMinimum.derivation: the section makes durations nonnegative and rates non-negative; this quantity is additionally one the definition divides by, scales by, or spends, so zero is excluded as well and the bound is exclusive rather than inclusive

cap.description: The highest purchasable rank. The rank array's length is checked against this rather than both against a constant.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

ranks.description: One row per purchasable rank, from one to the cap.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

price_hyper_gold.description: What this rank costs. Prices are not required to increase with rank: no accepted document says they must, and asserting it would reject a flat ladder a designer is free to author.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

revival.title: The revival parameters
revival.description: The parameters of the revival-charge effect kind, not a special-case field.

hull_restored_fraction_of_current_maximu.description: What share of current maximum Hull is restored.

exclusiveMinimum.derivation: the section names _fraction as a normalized unit; a revival restoring nothing is not a revival, so zero is excluded rather than admitted

maximum.derivation: the section names _fraction as a normalized unit, so the whole of a current maximum is 1 and a fraction cannot exceed what it is a fraction of

invulnerability_active_simulation_second.description: How long invulnerability lasts after revival.

minimum.derivation: the section states that durations are nonnegative and that rates cannot be negative, so the floor of every duration and rate is zero and there is no upper bound the section supplies

rechargeable_during_run.description: Whether a charge can be regained mid-run.

active_rank_policy.title: The active-rank policy
active_rank_policy.description: What the player may set and what it costs.

minimum_active_rank.description: The lowest rank the player may set active. Zero means the PowerUp may be switched off entirely.

minimum.derivation: the section makes counts integral; this one is summed into a report column across the catalog, so zero is authored rather than omitted and the floor is zero rather than one

maximum_active_rank_equals_purchased_ran.description: Whether the active rank is capped at the purchased one.

changeable_between_runs.description: Whether the active rank changes between runs.

changeable_during_run.description: Whether the active rank changes during a run.

change_cost_hyper_gold.description: What changing the active rank costs. Free is zero and is authored rather than omitted, because the economy report has a column for it.

minimum.derivation: the section makes counts integral; this one is summed into a report column across the catalog, so zero is authored rather than omitted and the floor is zero rather than one

rules.description: The accepted rule sentences for this PowerUp.

version.title: A positive integer version
version.description: The initial schema_version and content_version of every first-authored definition is 1.

minimum.derivation: the initial value of every first-authored definition is 1 and both versions only ever increment, so no valid version is below 1; there is no upper bound because a definition may be revised without limit

name_key.title: Localization key for the player-facing name

summary_key.title: Localization key for the concise player-facing summary

tags.title: Closed query and tooling vocabulary
tags.description: The vocabulary starts empty, so [] is the only accepted value.

presentation_id.title: Logical presentation entry, required absent
presentation_id.description: Required absent: a definition carrying this field is an error. No accepted document says what a presentation definition contains, so no ID grammar has been minted for one, and minting a shape for a category with zero members would be inventing structure ahead of need. The field was declared-optional with a non-empty-string constraint, which accepted any string an author invented and validated nothing about it; rejecting the field outright fails loudly the first time somebody adds one instead of accepting an unauthorized value. The subschema is 'not' over the empty schema, which rejects every instance, so the fault is the field's presence rather than its shape and an authored empty string is rejected by the same rule rather than as an empty declared-optional field. The typed validator reports MMC-2010 and names the field. When an accepted document mints a presentation ID grammar, this declaration becomes that grammar; until then it has no minLength, because a length bound on a value that can never be authored explains nothing.
